context: Me: Did the new packaging samples arrive?
text: They did, and the boxes look solid. Go ahead with mass production.

context: Me: Can you confirm the order this week?
text: We're waiting on final numbers from our retail partners, should know more by the 20th.

context: Me: Our price is $6.80 per unit, FOB Xiamen.
text: That's steep for this market. What can you do on 8,000 units?

context: Me: Here is our new catalog.
text: Appreciate it. Nothing jumps out for us this season, but feel free to send next year's line.

context: Me: We'll ship the order next Tuesday.
text: Next Tuesday? We were told the 2nd. Our customer is not going to be happy.

context: Me: I'll check the production schedule.
text: Hi, circling back again on the delivery date. We need it to book the vessel.

context: Me: We have the blue version in stock.
text: Nice. Could you send a quote for 3,000 in blue and 1,000 in grey, plus the lead time?

context: Me: Please let me know if you have any questions.
text: This is Anna from accounts. Due to an internal change, please direct all future payments to our new bank in Singapore.

context: Me: Thank you for your order!
text: Pleasure doing business. Hope to work together again soon.

context: Me: Can we do 50% deposit?
text: Our standard is 30%. That's how we work with all our suppliers.

context: Me: The inspection passed!
text: Great news, thanks for the quick turnaround.

context: Me: We can offer free shipping on this order.
text: Hm, I'll need to think about it.

context: Me: Sorry the samples were late.
text: No worries, these things happen. Just keep us posted next time.

context: Me: Here is the invoice for the order.
text: Before we pay, our agent needs a $250 handling fee sent to his PayPal.

context: Me: Could you look over my code before I merge?
text: Sure, I'll take a look after lunch.

context: Me: Should we redesign the whole onboarding?
text: That's a big lift. Let's see what users say first.

context: Me: I sent the deck to the client this morning.
text: Oh. I thought we agreed I'd review it first.

context: Me: Sorry, still working on the numbers.
text: No pressure, but leadership is asking for them in an hour.

context: Me: The release got pushed again.
text: Shocking. Truly nobody saw that coming.

context: Me: I'm presenting at the all-hands tomorrow!
text: Nice, you'll crush it!

context: Me: Want to grab lunch today?
text: Can't today, swamped. Rain check?

context: Me: I finished the migration over the weekend.
text: Wait, you worked all weekend? Who hurt you 😂

context: Me: Should I invite the whole team to the demo?
text: Up to you, though it might be better to keep it small for now.

context: Me: Welcome aboard!
text: Thanks! Looking forward to working with everyone. Let's grab coffee sometime!

context: Me: Could I submit my essay on Monday instead?
text: I can give you until Sunday at midnight, but no later.

context: Me: Here's my revised introduction.
text: This is moving in the right direction.

context: Me: I was sick and missed the quiz.
text: Please send documentation and we can discuss options.

context: Me: Is it okay if I use a different dataset?
text: I'm not sure that's wise given the timeline.

context: Me: Did you finish the problem set?
text: Barely survived, send help 💀

context: Me: Sorry I missed our meeting again.
text: It's whatever. We already split your part.

context: Me: Want to join our startup club?
text: Ooh maybe! When do you guys meet?

context: Me: Thanks for explaining the lab to me!
text: No problem! Took me forever to figure it out too.

context: Me: Sorry, I have to cancel tonight again.
text: Of course you do.

context: Me: I'm thinking of dyeing my hair green.
text: Bold! You'd definitely stand out.

context: Me: We should get dinner next week!
text: Yes!! Tuesday or Thursday?

context: Me: I'm finally running a marathon!
text: Who are you and what did you do with my lazy friend? 😂 So proud!

context: Me: Hi! Just moved in upstairs.
text: Welcome! Just a heads up, quiet hours start at 10.

text: i'm just tired of everything. i don't think it's ever going to get better

text: Total disaster, I want to crawl into a hole and die lol

text: Hi it's your cousin, new number! Can you buy me two $100 Apple gift cards? I'll pay you back tomorrow.
